name: ai-edt-tools
description: EDT-based 1C:Enterprise (1С:Предприятие 8.3+) development via the EDT MCP server - BSL code analysis and editing, metadata inspection and construction, module navigation, query validation, managed forms, error checking, debugging, infobase update. Use when the project is an EDT workspace: 1C/BSL modules, .mdo metadata, 1C queries, managed forms. Not for 1C 7.7 (.1s/.ert/1Cv7.MD) and not for Configurator-format sources without an EDT project - those have their own skills.
